ocean_bed.about: The ocean at rest: a held fifth and a little wind, always on, very low

stir.about: The ocean stirs into a new arrangement

peek.about: A piece of the ocean comes up to be looked at

stand.about: A tree stands up out of the ocean (a brief, a saved tree, the first film)

press.about: The clap: the tree is pressed flat into one card

send.about: The pressed card leaves for the tray (sent)

put_away.about: The pressed card goes to the shelf (put away)

hover.about: The pointer comes to rest on something you can pick

take.about: A card is asked about: it rises to the next layer and opens

think.about: The gardener is thinking (loops until the answer comes)

step_out.about: A pinch on nothing: the open card closes

zoom_out.about: Back out of the open card

lift.about: A card or a cover is picked up to be carried

place.about: It is set down where you put it

mark_begin.about: A mark starts on the open card (words, a stretch of video, part of a picture)

ask.about: A question is put to the gardener (a row under the card, or about a mark)

answer.about: The gardener's answer starts to arrive (then one ladder note per card)

link.about: A link is opened outside the app

cut.about: A thread is cut with the flat of the hand: the branch falls back into the water

grab.about: A hand closes on the tree (the gauge appears on the fist)

release.about: The hand opens: the tree coasts a little and stops

holo_wake.about: A finger comes over the small tree

momo_chime.about: Momo heard its name and listens

momo_sent.about: What the user said goes to Momo (the chime turned over, softer)

momo_thinking.about: Momo is thinking (loops until it speaks)
